Answers below.

**h01** — S3 presign refresh runner — every 12 hours (plus one immediate run at startup) — wired in `startBackgroundRunners`, `server/server.go:163` (immediate `RunOnce`) and `server/server.go:168-172` (`go s3presignRunner.Run(s3Context)`), called from `Start` at `server/server.go:130`.
- Component: `s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:16`; interval const `runnerInterval = 12h` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27`; work done in `CheckAndPresign` (`runner.go:47`), which re-presigns S3 object URLs whose last presign is older than 4 days (5-day expiry) and writes the new URL back via `Store.UpdateAttachment` (`runner.go:116`).

**h02**
- Delivery function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`; the actual HTTP call is `safeClient.Do(req)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:152`. (Callers enqueue via `PostAsync` → `asyncPostQueue` → 4 init-time worker goroutines, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-55,184`.)
- Protection: SSRF guard at dial time — `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:59-77`) installed as the shared client's `Transport.DialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:32-37`), which resolves the host and rejects reserved/private IPs via `isReservedIP`/`reservedCIDRs` — `internal/webhook/validate.go:210-250` (defeats DNS rebinding). Additionally `webhook.ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:258`) rejects non-http(s) and reserved-IP URLs at configuration time (e.g. `server/router/api/v1/user_service_webhooks.go:74`). Escape hatch: `AllowPrivateIPs` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:237`).

**h03**
- Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go:3`, `IdentityProviderUserInfo`).
- Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20,27` — OAuth2/OIDC, `NewIdentityProvider`, used at `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go:121`). It is the only concrete protocol implementation.

**h04** — no. Evidence: the only `mysql.NewDB` call is `store/db/db.go:22` inside `NewDBDriver`'s switch. A repo-wide `grep -rn "mysql\."` over `*.go` excluding `store/db/mysql/` returns only that line plus `store/test/containers.go:101-105`, which uses the unrelated `testcontainers` `mysql` module (test-only container startup), not the driver type.

**h05** — Explicit Go code (no DB-level cascade). Evidence:
- Explicit deletes per driver: `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` and `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx`, invoked from `deleteUserTargetsTx` — `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96,102` (defs at `:380,:400`), `store/db/postgres/user_delete.go:102,400`, `store/db/mysql/user_delete.go:102,437`.
- Schema has no FK/cascade on `reaction`: `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:91-99` (also `postgres/LATEST.sql:91-97`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:91-97`); the only `ON DELETE CASCADE` in any `LATEST.sql` is on `memo_share.memo_id` (`sqlite/LATEST.sql:108`, `postgres:108`, `mysql:108`).

**h06** — Handlers (all in `server/router/api/v1`):
- `CreateMemo` — `memo_service.go:70` → `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` at `memo_service.go:157`
- `UpdateMemo` — `memo_service.go:401` → `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` (`memo_service.go:513`) → `memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- `DeleteMemo` — `memo_service.go:518` → `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` at `memo_service.go:562`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:20` → `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` at `memo_service_comments.go:119`
- also `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16` → `:48`) and `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16` → `:48`)

Convergence function: `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (all paths reach it through `webhook.PostAsync`, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`, which feeds the worker pool that calls `Post`).

**h07**
- `serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (route `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`, registered `fileserver.go:124`; URL produced by `convertUserToProto`, `server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36`)
- `(*FileServerService).getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `(*Store).GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (user cache is consulted only for ID lookups, `store/user.go:149-156`)
- `(*Store).ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` → `s.driver.ListUsers` (`store/user.go:137`)
- `(*DB).ListUsers` (sqlite, default driver) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` — SELECTs `avatar_url` from table `user`
- back in the handler: `parseDataURI` (`fileserver.go:737`) decodes the base64 data URI, MIME allow-list check (`fileserver.go:201`, list at `:75`), then `c.Blob` (`fileserver.go:209`)

**h08** — two declarers:
- `(*s3presign.Runner).RunOnce` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked? yes — `server/server.go:163` (and self-invoked from `Run`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`)
- `(*memopayload.Runner).RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked? no — no callers anywhere (production or test); `memopayload.NewRunner` is likewise never called. Only the package-level `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`).

**h09** — 8 concrete `Close` method declarations in the backend (plus 2 interface declarations: `store.Driver.Close` at `store/driver.go:12` and `cache.Interface.Close` at `store/cache/cache.go:31`):
- `(*SSEHub).Close` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99` — called from `server/server.go:206` (`closeLongLivedConnections`)
- `(*Store).Close` — `store/store.go:72` — called from `server/server.go:146` (`Shutdown`)
- `(*cache.Cache).Close` — `store/cache/cache.go:187` — called 3× from `store/store.go:74-76`
- `(*sqlite.DB).Close` — `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`, `(*postgres.DB).Close` — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`, `(*mysql.DB).Close` — `store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47` — reached via the interface call `s.driver.Close()` at `store/store.go:78` (sqlite on a default install)
- Test-only, never called by server code: `(*MemoFilterTestContext).Close` — `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:200`; `(*AttachmentFilterTestContext).Close` — `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go:282`

**h10** — `(*filter.Engine).CompileToStatement` — `internal/filter/engine.go:74` — ~37 call sites (7 of them non-test: `store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go` ×2, `store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go`, `store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go`, `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`, `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go`, `internal/filter/helpers.go`). Close runners-up at ~28 call sites each: `util.GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go:40`) and the package-private `(*renderer).addArg` (`internal/filter/render.go:842`, all 28 within `render.go`).

**h11** — 1st: `store.User` (`store/user.go:38`) — referenced from ~7 packages outside `store/`: `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`. 2nd: `store.Memo` (`store/memo.go`) — ~6 packages: `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/frontend`, `server/router/rss`, `server/runner/memopayload`. (`store.Attachment` is next at ~4.)

**h12** — Concrete method: `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`; the `INSERT INTO memo ...` statement is built at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41` and executed at `:42`.
Determination: `Store.CreateMemo` only delegates to the interface (`store/memo.go:113`, `s.driver.CreateMemo`); the driver is chosen once in `db.NewDBDriver`'s switch on `profile.Driver` (`store/db/db.go:18-24`); with no flags, `driver` defaults to `"sqlite"` (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")` and `main.go:130` flag default), and the driver is built and handed to the store at `cmd/memos/main.go:57,64`. So the `case "sqlite"` branch (`store/db/db.go:20`) wins.

**h13**
- Implementation: the unexported `*markdown.service` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` (the only type implementing `markdown.Service`; sole `ExtractAll` implementation at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`).
- Construction: `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` — factory at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called in production only from `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48` (and in tests at `server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`).
- Holders of the interface: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected at `server/server.go:82`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`) and the free function `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`'s `markdownService` parameter (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`).

**h14**
- Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `MarkdownService.ExtractAll` — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`; results assigned to `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (`runner.go:85-86`).
- Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`); `UpdateMemo` when the update mask contains `content` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, payload written via `update.Payload` at `:450`); and the bulk rebuild `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) — which, note, is currently never invoked (see h08).
- Extracted: `Tags` (from `#tag` nodes) and `MemoPayload_Property` — `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks`, `Title` (first H1 heading) — `internal/markdown/markdown.go:376-408`, fields at `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-93`. (`Mentions` is also extracted but not stored in the payload.)

- `(*APIV1Service).checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo & friends) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68`
- `(*APIV1Service).ListMemos` visibility scoping of the query — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- `(*FileServerService).checkAttachmentPermission` (HTTP `/file/attachments/...`, incl. share-token fallback) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-704`
- `(*APIV1Service).checkAttachmentAccess` (AttachmentService) — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:422-454`
- `(*APIV1Service).ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-224`
- `(*APIV1Service).CreateMemoComment` / comments — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`
- Reaction service (`UpsertMemoReaction` / `DeleteMemoReaction`) — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30-40,83`
- SSE broadcast filter `(*SSEClient).canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:133-143`
- RSS feeds (public-only query) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90` and `:141`
- Sitemap/SSR frontend (public-only query) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`
- User stats/tag aggregation — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:84-90,218-220`
- Mention/notification fan-out — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62-84`, `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:309-312`, `server/notification/email.go:313-316`

**r01** — Premise is wrong: there is no Redis anywhere in the repo (`grep -rni redis` over Go and web sources returns nothing) and no cache "connection" to configure. Actual mechanism: a process-local, in-memory `sync.Map`-backed cache — `store/cache/cache.go` (`Cache` at `:67`, `New` at `:76`, TTL sweep goroutine). Three instances are created in `store.New` — `instanceSettingCache`, `userCache`, `userSettingCache` (`store/store.go:51-53`) — all sharing one config declared inline at `store/store.go:40-45`: `DefaultTTL: 10 * time.Minute`, `CleanupInterval: 5m`, `MaxItems: 1000`. So user entries expire after **10 minutes**, and are also invalidated explicitly on delete (`store/user_delete.go:39-46`). Cache hits for users only occur on ID lookups (`store/user.go:149`).

**r02** — Premise is wrong: there is no per-user (or any) rate-limiting middleware in this codebase, so it is registered nowhere and has no limits. The only Echo middleware registered is `middleware.Recover()` and the CORS middleware (`server/server.go:52-53`); the API pipeline adds only auth/logging/recovery/metadata interceptors (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:133-138`, `server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go`). The nearest things are concurrency limiters, not rate limits: `thumbnailSemaphore`/`imageProcessingSemaphore` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:59-60`), `maxAPIRequestBytes` body cap (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:20`), and the bounded 128-slot webhook queue (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`). The only mention of rate limiting is an aspirational comment at `internal/email/doc.go:86`.

**r03** — Premise is wrong: there is no nightly database-cleanup job and no cron scheduler running in the server. The `internal/scheduler` package (cron parser at `internal/scheduler/parser.go:30`, `Scheduler` at `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go:54`) exists but is imported only by its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go:13`) — nothing in `cmd/` or `server/` constructs or registers jobs with it. The only background work started at boot is the s3presign runner on a 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/server.go:155-175`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-41`), which refreshes presigned URLs rather than cleaning the database.

**r04** — Premise is wrong: neither. There is no message broker of any kind (`grep -rni "nats|rabbitmq|amqp|kafka"` over `*.go` returns nothing) and no queue is declared in any infrastructure. Actual mechanism: an in-process buffered Go channel — `asyncPostQueue = make(chan *WebhookRequestPayload, 128)` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`, drained by 4 goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`) that call `webhook.Post` (`:120`). Producers use `webhook.PostAsync` (`:184`), which drops the event with a warning when the buffer is full. State is purely in-memory, so queued deliveries are lost on restart.

**r05** — Premise is wrong: there is no GraphQL schema or server in this repo (no `graphql` hits in Go, TS/TSX). The public API surface is Protobuf/gRPC-defined and served three ways from the same `APIV1Service`: (1) REST/JSON via grpc-gateway on `/api/v1/*` and `/file/*` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:96-129`), (2) Connect RPC on `/memos.api.v1.*` for browser clients (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:139-144`), (3) generated code in `proto/gen/api/v1/` from the `.proto` definitions under `proto/api/v1/`. Non-RPC surfaces: SSE (`RegisterSSERoutes`, `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:125`), native file serving (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:121-125`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go`), MCP (`server/router/mcp/`), and `/healthz` (`server/server.go:64`).
